en.bdb: The result of association with the stupid one

verses.gurmukhi: ਠੰਢੇ ਖੂਹਹੁੰ ਨ੍ਹਾਇ ਕੈ ਪਗ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਨੰਗੈ।
verses.translit_en: Tha(n)dde khoohahu(n) nhai kai pag visaar aaiaa sir na(n)gai|

en.bdb: Having taken bath on the well, a person forgot his turban and returned home bare headed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੰਨਾ ਕਮਲੀਆਂ ਧੁਸੀ ਲੀਤੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਢੰਗੈ।
verses.translit_en: ghar vich ra(n)naa kamaleeaa(n) dhusee leetee dhekh kudda(n)gai|

en.bdb: Seeing his improper conduct (of being bare headed) the silly women started weeping and wailing (Seeing turbanless master of the house they conjectured the death of some one in the family).

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੰਨਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਿਟੰਦੀਆ ਢਾਹਾਂ ਮਾਰੈਂ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਸੰਗੈ।
verses.translit_en: ra(n)naa dhekh piTa(n)dheeaa ddaahaa(n) maarai(n) hoi nisa(n)gai|

en.bdb: Seeing the weeping women, others too, began mourning. People gethered and sitting in lines started condoling with the family.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਕ ਸਿਆਪੇ ਆਇਆ ਰੰਨਾ ਪੁਰਸ ਜੁੜੇ ਲੈ ਪੰਗੈ।
verses.translit_en: lok siaape aaiaa ra(n)naa puras juRe lai pa(n)gai|

en.bdb: Now the barber woman who leads the mourning on occasions asked as to who is to be wept and whose dirge she should lead, i.e. what is the name of the dead.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇਣ ਪੁਛਦੀ ਪਿਟਦੀਆਂ ਕਿਸ ਦੈ ਨਾਇ ਅਲ੍ਹਾਣੀ ਅੰਗੈ।
verses.translit_en: nain puchhadhee piTadheeaa(n) kis dhai nai alhaanee a(n)gai|

en.bdb: The daughter-in-law of family hinted towards father-in-law to elicit answer of this question (because he was found bare headed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹੁਰੇ ਪੁਛਹ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਕਉਣ ਮੁਆ ਨੂਹ ਉਤਰੁ ਮੰਗੈ।
verses.translit_en: sahure puchheh jai kai kaun muaa nooh utar ma(n)gai|

en.bdb: Then the fact was disclosed by him that he just forgot to wear turban).
In the assembly of the fools such cawing takes place (because crows also listening to one voice start cawing jointly).
